text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Conquering the year-end Grand Prix! Meisho 
Doto surpassed T.M. Opera O and the 
generation above her to stand at the very 
pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—This is no mere coincidence. Grass Wonder 
is a hidden gem that bloomed magnificently 
from behind T.M. Opera O. They praise it 
as an inevitable victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The road to becoming an Umamusume full of 
confidence is still underway. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who sought salvation from 
rock bottom achieved greatness, becoming a 
beacon of hope and salvation to others.
